title: XSS Prevention Techniques
description: Apply encoding, sanitization, and CSP to prevent XSS.

data.text: Preventing XSS requires multiple layers: encoding output, sanitizing input, and restricting script sources.
Encode data before rendering it in HTML. Convert special characters to their HTML entity equivalents.
React escapes values by default. JSX treats everything as text unless you use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
CSP is an HTTP header that restricts where scripts, styles, and other resources can load from.

data.title: Defense in Depth
data.text: Use output encoding, input validation, sanitization libraries, and CSP together for layered protection.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Combine multiple defenses for robust security
data.takeaway: Now let's apply these concepts to prevent CSRF attacks.
